'''Cambra Del''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. She spent time on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]] looking for jobs so she could pay off a loan shark that lent her credits to repair her [[YT-1000 light freighter/Legends|YT-1000]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. It was damaged when Cambra helped some [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents escape an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison and she had to dump her load of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the resulting confusion. While on Ord Mynock, she was hunted down by a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was to collect the 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] she still owed. During her search for jobs, she was approached by a mysterious man who suggested that it would be worth her while to keep an eye on [[Ellos Ripfire]] because he was going to need help soon.<ref name="Game" />
